title: 14 April 1964: Filming: A Hard Day's Night
content:
The Beatles filmed studio and on-location scenes for the A Hard Day’s Night film on this day, at Twickenham Film Studios and on the nearby Arlington Road.

In the scene, The Beatles were stuck in a traffic jam and were shouted at by a passenger in another car. However, it was later decided that the sequence should be omitted from the final cut.

Page last updated: 4 April 2010

  • 1966: Recording, mixing: Paperback Writer, Rain
  • 1965: Filming: Help!
  • 1963: The Beatles see The Rolling Stones perform for the first time
  • 1963: Television: Thank Your Lucky Stars

  • 1961: The Beatles live: Top Ten Club, Hamburg
